CHILL BEACH BAR
Jul 2025 • Friends
Located on Ky Quan Street, Chill Beach Bar is easy to find—just search the name and you’ll get there. Nearby is Valley Beach Bar, a trendy hotspot among Ha Long’s younger crowd. Chill Beach Bar has a beautiful Mediterranean-style vibe with a relaxing sea view, perfect for those looking for a quieter spot to take photos. During busy times, it’s best to reserve in advance. You can choose from beanbags, wooden chairs, or more private seating. The music is good, the staff are friendly and attentive. Drinks are on the pricier side and not particularly unique, but the atmosphere makes up for it.

Not chill at all
Mar 2025 • Family
I was looking forward to a nice day on the beach with nice tones and food. Upon arrival most employees were hanging or sitting at the bar. When we asked for a sun/day bef that was not available because it had rained the night before. We ended at the beach but the beanbags were still on the spot where guest left them. No atmosphere. We ordered 3 drinks and besides my reservation for lunch I needed to pay at every order. 
When we did want to go for lunch, seated the DJ was playing so loud that we decided to leave. When I explained it to the waiter he said it was a test. For us it was an hour to loud music in a poor environment with only 6 guests. A bummer because everyone was in the mood to unwind, unfortunately at Chill they don’t have a clue what chill is.
